handoffs.message: Helper-claimed by idle Codex2; previous owner Codex becomes reviewer.

Review commit b3bf9de15: concrete no-list encrypted PrivateContentStore; owner-scope/audit/idempotency/expiry coverage; workshop pcnt_ULID and redacted-summary wiring. Verified privacy 8 passed and workshop 68 passed.

Review changes requested for b3bf9de15. (1) Preserve workshop/private-store consistency: post-message writes private content before append_event_if_version; a stale If-Match/CAS failure leaves an unreferenced encrypted object. Add rollback/delete-on-failure or an atomic/reservation design, plus a regression test proving failed CAS leaves no retrievable orphan. (2) Fix idempotency scope: MemoryPrivateContentStore keys only (tenant_id, owner_user_id, idempotency_key), so key reuse across workshops/events returns the prior descriptor. Bind idempotency to the full logical write identity and reject same-key/different-payload or identity conflicts; add cross-workshop and conflict tests. Existing focused suites pass: privacy 8, workshop 68.

Reviewer fixes anchored at d5a1821f1: stale CAS now hard-discards ciphertext/DEK/idempotency state; idempotency binds full logical identity and rejects payload conflicts. Verified privacy 10 passed and workshop 69 passed.

Review changes required: create_workshop is not failure-atomic. It persists the session before private_content_store.put, then persists ciphertext before store.create_event, with no compensation. A private-store failure leaves an empty workshop; an event-write failure leaves unreferenced ciphertext/DEK. Add rollback/transaction compensation for both boundaries (including hard-discard after event failure), add focused regression tests proving no orphan private object and no partial session, then rerun privacy + workshop suites.

Review requested for 8be97f3df. create_workshop now compensates session/idempotency on private-store failure and hard-discards private object before session compensation on event failure; focused workshop + privacy suites: 81 passed.

APPROVED: reviewed commits b3bf9de15, d5a1821f1, and 8be97f3df; private-content ownership, opacity, idempotency, redaction, and failure compensation satisfy the execution packet. Independent verification: 81 passed.
